description: Verify that DHCPREQUEST in REBINDING fills 'ciaddr' with the client's IP address (RFC 2131 §4.4.5)
approach:
[Objective]
Like REQUEST_08 for RENEWING: the rebound IP must travel in ciaddr so any responding server can match it against an existing lease record. Without it, no server can identify which binding to extend.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. DORA → BOUND with yiaddr = Y.
2. T1 → RENEWING REQUEST.
3. T2 → REBINDING → rebind DHCPREQUEST
   • ciaddr == Y   ← key check

[Pass condition]
REBINDING REQUEST.ciaddr equals the bound client IP.

[Fail condition]
Any chain step missing OR Fail_rebinding_request_ciaddr_mismatch — ciaddr is not the bound IP.

verdicts.Fail_no_discover: No DUT DHCPDISCOVER within the listen window
verdicts.Fail_no_renewing_request: No DUT renewing DHCPREQUEST after ACK
verdicts.Fail_no_rebinding_request: No DUT rebinding DHCPREQUEST within listen window
